headline: Camden Living acquires two multifamily properties in Arizona; training expansion and onboarding opportunity for new teams

signals.summary: Camden Living acquired a 320-unit multifamily community in Gilbert, Arizona. This represents material portfolio growth for the operator and adds a new property requiring team training and compliance setup.
signals.suggestedAction: Contact Anneli Joplin and Cynthia Hodder to confirm onboarding timeline for the Gilbert property team to PerformanceHQ. Offer to: (1) conduct a training-needs assessment for the new management and leasing staff; (2) migrate or create location-specific Learning Plans for the 320 units; (3) brief the new team on the compliance-tracking benefits they've already realized post-November 2024 upgrade.
